title: New Zealand is investing $202 million in a mega-operation aimed at restoring three islands destroyed by invasive species
summary_full: In an inspiring ecological restoration project, New Zealand is teaming up with Māori natives to tackle invasive mammal populations on three major islands, including Maukahuka, Rakiura, and the Chatham archipelago. This extensive collaboration among governmental bodies, local communities, and Indigenous organizations aims to breathe new life into native wildlife. The success of this project could highlight New Zealand's pioneering methods in environmental restoration on the world stage.
